units.source_text: 性毫无道理地必须忍受贴上赠答用礼签。

en.t: Sex has to endure, for no reason at all, having a ceremonial gift label stuck onto it.

units.source_text: 性每天早晨该用熨斗烫烫平整……

en.t: Sex ought to be pressed smooth with an iron every morning...

units.source_text: 性穿过袖口的时候，就已经变得陈旧了……

en.t: By the time sex passes through the cuff, it has already grown old...

units.source_text: 熨斗一烫，皱纹展平，立刻犹如新品……

en.t: One touch of the iron, and the wrinkles smooth out, instantly making it seem brand-new...

units.source_text: 刚成为新的，立刻又要变旧……

en.t: No sooner has it become new than it must grow old again...

units.source_text: 这样卑猥的话，难道有义务认真地侧耳去听吗？

en.t: Is there really any obligation to listen seriously to such obscene talk?
